tables.name: visit_marks
tables.description: One row per visit for what happens at it: FS line 729's checked_in_at, done_at and done_by, which K-30 leaves to this part. It holds how the visit was checked in (the code from the pro's own phone or the desk's Today page, a roster tick, a drop-off or a mail-in, or a self check-in), the wrong code tries in a row (their times only, never the digits typed) and when the owner was told after the third, a visit with no code, a self check-in's 'I've left', and how the visit ended: done (the pro's DONE, the desk, the owner's yes when nothing was entered by night, or the code when nothing is billed after), part (PART: stopped partway, priced for what was done), not started (whose side), stopped (safety, a finding, conduct or a first step), the door kept shut, or it did not happen. Written at the visit's first mark; each value is set once and never changed (README rule 7, trigger visit_marks_set_once). A no-show mark is its own row (no_shows).
tables.source: 02-contracts section 7 row K-31 ('Check-ins (the code entered, wrong tries), DONE (when and by whom)'); FS line 729 (checked_in_at, done_at, done_by); A8-03 to A8-10, A8-70, A8-87; B8-03 to B8-08, B8-40, B8-41; K-30 v1 README ('K-31 the visit (F17) will name booking_visits.id for check-ins, DONE and no-shows and owns FS line 729's checked_in_at, done_at and done_by')

columns.name: visit_id
columns.description: The visit (K-30 booking_visits.id), held to its booking by visit_marks_visit_fk: one row per visit, written at its first mark.
columns.source: K-30 v1 booking_visits.id ('The visit part (K-31) names it for check-ins, DONE and no-shows'); A7-01 ('Each later day ... gets its own reminder, with a new code')

columns.name: booking_id
columns.description: The visit's booking (K-04 bookings.id).
columns.source: FS line 729; K-04 v1 bookings

columns.name: business_id
columns.description: The booking's business (README rule 5 holds it), so row-level security can scope the row.
columns.source: arch 10 line 546; K-04 v1 rule 4

columns.name: checked_in_at
columns.description: When the visit was checked in: the right code entered, a roster tick, a drop-off's code, a mail-in's arrival or a self check-in. It confirms the visit (A8-03: 'The code confirms the visit'), and the first check-in code is when K-32 counts the $2 (Q-22). The pro is told ('Checked in: Alex M., Sat 11:00am'), and in flow B the customer too. Null until then; set once.
columns.source: FS line 729 (checked_in_at); A8-03, A8-04, A8-06; B8-04 ('Jordan from Lee Home Services is checked in for your 8–10am visit'); FS line 618 (Today); K-32 v1 rosfield_fees (counted at the first check-in code); Q-22

columns.name: checked_in_how
columns.description: code (the visit's check-in code, K-30 booking_visits.check_in_code, checked by code against the sealed value: A8-04, A8-06, B8-04), roster (the desk ticks names on the Today page at a class: A8-09), drop_off (the code given when the item is left: A8-10), mail_in (no code: it counts when the item arrives, A8-10) or self (no staff there: ID checked on the secure page, A8-70).

columns.name: checked_in_by_person_id
columns.description: Who entered it (persons.id): the pro, from their own phone, so 'checked in' shows who came (B8-04), or the desk on the Today page (A8-04; FS line 618). Null for a self check-in.
columns.source: B8-04 ('Only the pro's own phone can enter the code, so checked in shows who came'); A8-04 ('From Riley's phone, or the portal's Today page at the desk'); FS line 618

columns.name: checked_in_via
columns.description: staff_text (a text from the pro's or the desk's own phone), today_page (the owner console's Today page) or secure_page (a self check-in).

columns.name: wrong_try_1_at
columns.description: When the first wrong code in a row was entered ('That isn't Alex M.'s code. Check it with them and send it again'). Only the time is kept, never the digits typed: a code is checked once more and never guessed. Set once.
columns.source: A8-03 ('A code typed with a typo is checked once more, never guessed'); A8-05; B8-05; FS line 668 (screen 18)

columns.name: wrong_try_2_at
columns.description: When the second wrong code in a row was entered; only the time. Set once.
columns.source: A8-05 ('3 wrong tries: three wrong in a row'); B8-05

columns.name: wrong_try_3_at
columns.description: When the third wrong code in a row was entered; only the time. After it no code is taken: the owner is told, the visit goes on, and DONE at the end counts it. Set once.
columns.source: A8-05; A8-07 ('After 3 wrong tries, Sam is told ... The visit goes on, and Riley's DONE at the end counts it'); B8-06; FS line 668 ('after 3 wrong tries the owner is told')

columns.name: tries_told_at
columns.description: When the owner was told after the third wrong try, and in flow B the customer as well ('If the person at your door isn't Jordan, don't let them in').

columns.name: no_code_at
columns.description: When the pro noted that there is no code (the customer's phone is away: 'NO CODE Alex M. Phone is away.'), so DONE at the end confirms the visit instead.

columns.name: left_at
columns.description: A self check-in's 'I've left', which closes the visit. None by the end gets one text; no answer in 15 minutes, the owner is told and a safety check follows (never an overtime fee on silence).
columns.source: A8-70 ('Kai taps I've left to close the visit')

columns.name: ended_at
columns.description: When the visit was marked to end, once: DONE's or PART's time, the owner's answer, or when it could not start or stopped (A8-87: 'One event, one moment: the visit is marked done once, here').
columns.source: A8-87; B8-40 ('One DONE per visit'); B8-41

columns.name: ended_how
columns.description: done (the work is done: the pro's DONE, the desk's mark, the owner's 1 Yes, mark it done after nothing was entered by night, or the code when nothing is billed after and no date was promised); part (PART: it stopped partway, and only what was done is charged); not_started (something required is missing or a conflict is found: whose side says what is charged); stopped (stopped for safety, a finding, conduct or a first step that is not OK); door_shut (the customer said the person at the door is not the pro, and the door stayed shut: no fee); didnt_happen (the owner's 2 It didn't happen: nothing more is charged).

columns.name: done_by_person_id
columns.description: Who marked it done or part (persons.id): the pro who texted DONE or PART, the desk, or the owner who answered 1 Yes, mark it done; null when the code confirmed it (done_via code).
columns.source: FS line 729 (done_by); A8-87; B8-41; A8-47; B8-47; FS line 618

columns.name: done_via
columns.description: staff_text (DONE or PART from the pro's or the desk's own phone), today_page (the desk marks it done on the Today page), owner_yes (the owner's answer when nothing was entered by night) or code (checked in with the code, nothing billed after and no ready date promised: nothing more is needed).
columns.source: A8-87 ('Checked in with the code'; 'The pro texts DONE'); B8-41; FS line 618; A8-47; B8-47; Q-13

columns.name: side
columns.description: Whose side a visit that could not start, or stopped, is on: customer (theirs to bring: any fee is the owner's question), business (nothing is charged) or customer_state (they arrived impaired, refused a safety rule or gave an answer that was not true: money follows the signed terms). Required when it did not start. A stop takes it where the plug-in or the step says (a first step that is not OK, or a safety stop where the plug-in sets no rule of its own, is the business's side).
columns.source: A8-51 ('Whose side is it on?'; 'Safe default: the business's side'); A8-56; A8-61; A8-81; B8-54; A8-72 ('That's the business's side'); A8-40 ('the part not given is the business's side')

columns.name: stopped_why
columns.description: Why it stopped: safety (it isn't safe to go on, or the pro feels unsafe and leaves), finding (a finding stops the work, with a written note), conduct (ended for conduct) or first_step (the first step shows it can't go ahead safely today). The details go only on the secure page, never here.
columns.source: A8-40; B8-29; A8-35; B8-30; A8-80; B8-88; A8-72; B8-90; A8-86 ('Details go only on the secure page')

columns.name: done_price_id
columns.description: The DONE's or PART's total and lines (visit_prices of kind done or part, of this visit): every money message after the visit reads these lines. Null when the owner's yes lets the bill go as booked, or the code confirmed the visit.
columns.source: B8-41 ('Every money message after the visit reads these lines'); A8-37 ('texts PART with the price of what was done'); A8-87; A8-47 ('the bill goes as booked')

columns.name: photo_key
columns.description: DONE's photo when nobody needs to be home: the object key of the photo in the private file store (K-13), never the photo. It rides on the first message after the visit, the bill or the receipt.
columns.source: B8-17 ('DONE needs a photo'; 'The DONE photo rides on the first message after the visit, the bill or the receipt'); B8-41; B9-06; 02-contracts row K-13

columns.name: report_by
columns.description: A report promised by a date: DONE says that date, a day in the visit's zone (README rule 9).
columns.source: A8-87 ('A report promised by a date: DONE says that date'); B8-41

columns.name: version
columns.description: The row's version: every update raises it by one, and a commit compares and sets it, so a write made from an old read is refused with the rows that changed (limit 4).
columns.source: arch 01 line 85; arch 10 line 506; K-04 v1 rule 2

unique.name: visit_marks_done_price_key
unique.source: B8-41 (one DONE per visit: a DONE's lines bill one visit)

checks.name: visit_marks_check_in_how_known
checks.expression: checked_in_how is null or checked_in_how in ('code', 'roster', 'drop_off', 'mail_in', 'self')

checks.name: visit_marks_check_in_via_known
checks.expression: checked_in_via is null or checked_in_via in ('staff_text', 'today_page', 'secure_page')

checks.name: visit_marks_checked_in_together
checks.expression: (checked_in_at is null) = (checked_in_how is null) and (checked_in_at is null) = (checked_in_via is null) and (checked_in_at is not null or checked_in_by_person_id is null)

checks.name: visit_marks_who_checked_in
checks.expression: checked_in_at is null or (checked_in_how = 'self' and checked_in_via = 'secure_page' and checked_in_by_person_id is null) or (checked_in_how <> 'self' and checked_in_via in ('staff_text', 'today_page') and checked_in_by_person_id is not null)
checks.source: B8-04 ('checked in shows who came'); A8-04; A8-70

checks.name: visit_marks_wrong_tries_in_order
checks.expression: (wrong_try_2_at is null or (wrong_try_1_at is not null and wrong_try_2_at >= wrong_try_1_at)) and (wrong_try_3_at is null or (wrong_try_2_at is not null and wrong_try_3_at >= wrong_try_2_at))

checks.name: visit_marks_told_after_third
checks.expression: tries_told_at is null or (wrong_try_3_at is not null and tries_told_at >= wrong_try_3_at)

checks.name: visit_marks_code_before_third
checks.expression: checked_in_how is distinct from 'code' or (wrong_try_3_at is null and checked_in_at >= coalesce(wrong_try_2_at, wrong_try_1_at, checked_in_at))
checks.source: A8-05; A8-06 ('The next try matches, so it's a normal check-in'); A8-07 (after 3 wrong tries, DONE counts it)

checks.name: visit_marks_left_after_self_check_in

checks.name: visit_marks_ended_how_known
checks.expression: ended_how is null or ended_how in ('done', 'part', 'not_started', 'stopped', 'door_shut', 'didnt_happen')

checks.name: visit_marks_ended_together
checks.expression: (ended_at is null) = (ended_how is null) and (ended_at is null or checked_in_at is null or ended_at >= checked_in_at)

checks.name: visit_marks_done_via_known
checks.expression: done_via is null or done_via in ('staff_text', 'today_page', 'owner_yes', 'code')

checks.name: visit_marks_done_with_how
checks.expression: coalesce(ended_how in ('done', 'part'), false) = (done_via is not null)

checks.name: visit_marks_done_by
checks.expression: (done_via is not null and done_via <> 'code') = (done_by_person_id is not null)

checks.name: visit_marks_done_by_code
checks.expression: done_via is distinct from 'code' or (ended_how = 'done' and coalesce(checked_in_how = 'code', false) and done_price_id is null)
checks.source: A8-87 ('Checked in with the code: the code came in, nothing is billed after, and no ready date was promised')

checks.name: visit_marks_part_priced
checks.expression: ended_how is distinct from 'part' or (coalesce(done_via in ('staff_text', 'today_page'), false) and done_price_id is not null)
checks.source: A8-37 ('texts PART with the price of what was done. It's read back like a bill'); B8-80

checks.name: visit_marks_owner_yes_as_booked
checks.expression: done_via is distinct from 'owner_yes' or (ended_how = 'done' and done_price_id is null)
checks.source: A8-47 ('Sam marks it done, and the bill goes as booked'); B8-47; Q-13

checks.name: visit_marks_done_text_has_lines
checks.expression: done_via is distinct from 'staff_text' or done_price_id is not null
checks.source: B8-41 ('Jordan texts DONE with the total and its lines'); A8-87 ('DONE 35 haircut')

checks.name: visit_marks_done_price_when_done
checks.expression: done_price_id is null or coalesce(ended_how in ('done', 'part'), false)

checks.name: visit_marks_never_met
checks.expression: ended_how is null or ended_how not in ('door_shut', 'didnt_happen') or checked_in_at is null
checks.source: B8-07 ('Nothing counts until Jordan checks in'); A8-47 (no code and no DONE)

checks.name: visit_marks_side_known
checks.expression: side is null or side in ('customer', 'business', 'customer_state')

checks.name: visit_marks_side_when
checks.expression: (ended_how is distinct from 'not_started' or side is not null) and (side is null or coalesce(ended_how in ('not_started', 'stopped'), false))

checks.name: visit_marks_stopped_why_known
checks.expression: stopped_why is null or stopped_why in ('safety', 'finding', 'conduct', 'first_step')

checks.name: visit_marks_stopped_with_why
checks.expression: coalesce(ended_how = 'stopped', false) = (stopped_why is not null)

checks.name: visit_marks_photo_report_with_done
checks.expression: (photo_key is null and report_by is null) or done_via is not null

indexes.name: visit_marks_booking_idx
indexes.why: A booking's visits' marks: the record and journey 9's visit_done (A9-01 needs visit_done).

tables.name: visit_prices
tables.description: Each price set at a visit, with its lines in visit_price_lines: a price made at the visit for a service priced at the visit (only the consult or service call was promised), an extra (more work, more time or another way, priced first), and the DONE's or PART's total and lines that every money message after the visit reads. A price over the owner's limit, or made where the owner's rule asks for an OK, goes to the owner first (the answer in K-08's ownerYes shape); then the customer sees it and says yes to all, not today or some lines, asks for a change, or does not answer. A price is never edited: the owner's change or the customer's asked change is a new row naming the one it replaces. Each answer is set once (README rule 7, trigger visit_prices_set_once).
tables.source: 02-contracts section 7 row K-31 ('prices and extras set at the visit'); A8-24 to A8-31, A8-33, A8-37, A8-48, A8-49, A8-87, A8-88; B8-19 to B8-26, B8-41, B8-48, B8-49, B8-77, B8-80, B8-92, B8-93; K-08 v1 approvalOwnerYes; K-32 v1 README open gaps ('Extras set at the visit (K-31, F17)')

columns.name: id
columns.description: The price's id: an opaque string code makes and never parses (CQ-09).
columns.source: CQ-09

columns.name: visit_id
columns.description: The visit it was set at (K-30 booking_visits.id), held to its booking by visit_prices_visit_fk.

columns.name: booking_id
columns.description: The visit's booking (K-04 bookings.id).
columns.source: FS line 729; K-04 v1 bookings

columns.name: business_id
columns.description: The booking's business (README rule 5), so row-level security can scope the row.
columns.source: arch 10 line 546

columns.name: kind
columns.description: at_visit (a service priced at the visit: only the consult or service call was promised, and nothing more is done until the customer says yes), extra (extra work, more time or another way during the visit: priced first, and the customer's own yes), done (the DONE's total and lines: the booked work, extras with their yes, parts at cost) or part (PART: the price of what was done when the work stops partway).

columns.name: replaces_price_id
columns.description: The price this one replaces (visit_prices.id, of the same visit): after the owner's 2 Change it (the owner types a new price, read back first) or the customer's asked change (priced again, shown again). A price is replaced at most once.
columns.source: A8-26 ('Sam types a new price, read back to Sam before it goes'); A8-88; B8-92; B8-77

columns.name: priced_by_person_id
columns.description: Who set it (persons.id): the pro who texted it (a price, an extra, DONE or PART), or the owner who changed it.

columns.name: priced_at
columns.description: When it was set.

columns.name: total_cents
columns.description: The total in integer minor units (cents for USD), never a decimal: the price shown, or DONE's total ($0 for a free estimate declined).
columns.source: A8-25 ('$125 in all'); B8-92 ('$620'); B8-41 ('DONE 179 drain'); B9-01 ('DONE's total is $0'); CQ-09; K-30 v1 README 'Money'

columns.name: currency
columns.description: The three-letter currency code (USD in the demo shops).
columns.source: CQ-09; K-32 v1 README 'Money'

columns.name: included_cents
columns.description: For a price made at the visit: the consult or service call its total includes ('The $25 consult included'; 'The $89 service call is included'). Null otherwise.
columns.source: A8-25; A8-26; B8-20 ('The visit or consult fee is part of the quote'); B8-92; B8-93

columns.name: price_ok_limit_id
columns.description: The owner's price OK limit that sends it to the owner first (K-26 price_ok_limits.id), when it is over that limit.
columns.source: B8-20 ('Over Sam's limit: Sam first'); B8-92 ('over your $500 limit'); A8-33 ('A price over Sam's limit goes to Sam first'); B8-23; A8-37; K-26 v1 price_ok_limits

columns.name: rule_id
columns.description: The owner's rule that asks for an OK of every price made at the visit (K-26 rules.id), as at the barbershop ('At the shop, only Sam OKs prices made at the chair').
columns.source: A8-26 ('A price made for one customer goes to Sam first, as Sam set it'); K-26 v1 rules

columns.name: owner_asked_at
columns.description: When the owner was asked to OK it, at once, whenever a limit or a rule asks: nothing goes out until someone OKs it.
columns.source: A8-26 ('Never: send a price made at the chair without Sam's OK, where Sam's rule asks for one'); B8-92

columns.name: owner_answer_by
columns.description: 30 minutes after the owner was asked: with no answer by then, the customer hears it is with the owner (a DONE's or PART's total waits).
columns.source: A8-26 ('No answer in 30 minutes, by 11:35am here: nothing goes out, and the customer hears it's with Sam'); A8-28; B8-92 ('No answer in 30 minutes: Alex is told it's with the owner'); A8-37 ('No OK in 30 minutes: the bill or charge waits')

columns.name: owner_reminded_at
columns.description: When the owner got the one reminder.
columns.source: A8-28 ('Nothing goes out until someone OKs it, and Sam gets one reminder')

columns.name: owner_answer
columns.description: send (1 Send it) or change (2 Change it: the owner's new price, read back to the owner first, is a new row naming this one).
columns.source: A8-26 ('Means 1: send it. Means 2: Sam types a new price'); B8-92

columns.name: owner_answered_at
columns.description: When the owner answered.
columns.source: A8-26; K-08 v1 approvalOwnerYes

columns.name: owner_answered_by_person_id
columns.description: Who answered (persons.id): the owner, or an admin the owner lets OK prices (K-08 ownerYes person).

columns.name: owner_answered_by_role
columns.description: owner or admin (K-08 ownerYes role).
columns.source: K-08 v1 approvalOwnerYes

columns.name: owner_open_question_id

columns.source: K-08 v1 approvalOwnerYes; K-04 v1 open_questions

columns.name: owner_option_id
columns.description: The option chosen, as sent (K-08 ownerYes option).
columns.source: K-08 v1 approvalOwnerYes

columns.name: owner_event_id
columns.description: The inbound event that carried the answer (K-08 ownerYes event).
columns.source: K-08 v1 approvalOwnerYes

columns.name: shown_at
columns.description: When the customer was shown it, before any work ('Nothing is done until you say yes'), after the owner's OK where one is asked. Prices made at the visit and extras only.
columns.source: A8-29 ('Once Sam OKs it, the customer sees the price before any work'); B8-93; A8-33; B8-23

columns.name: customer_open_question_id
columns.description: The question the customer answered (K-04 open_questions.id).
columns.source: A8-29; B8-93; K-04 v1 open_questions

columns.name: customer_reminded_at
columns.description: When the customer got the one reminder (a drop-off after 2 hours; at a home after 15 minutes); still no answer, the owner picks whether to reach them.

columns.name: customer_answer
columns.description: yes (1 Yes, do it: all of it), not_today (2 Not today, or 2 No, just the booked work: only what was promised; a price still waiting for the owner's OK goes as not today), some_lines (3 OK some lines: only the lines marked yes are done and billed today), changes (asks for a change: priced again as a new row) or none (no answer after the one reminder and the owner's pick: nothing priced is done). Prices made at the visit and extras only.
columns.source: A8-29; A8-30; A8-48; A8-88; A8-49; A8-28 ('No reply: the consult only'); B8-93; B8-21; B8-48; B8-77; B8-49; B8-92 ('A quote still waiting then is treated as Not today'); A8-33; B8-23; B8-25

tables.name: no_shows
tables.description: A no-show mark on a visit and what follows it: 15 minutes after the start (10 for a video or phone session nobody joined) the pro or the desk marks the customer as not there; where they may be unable to answer, a safety check comes first and no fee or no-show words go until they are found safe (alerts per Q-06); then the customer is asked to reply within 30 minutes; their reply, and how the mark ended. No fee is asked here: any fee is the owner's question (K-32 booking_fees), only after the customer is heard. One per visit; each value set once (README rule 7, trigger no_shows_set_once).
tables.source: 02-contracts section 7 row K-31 ('no-show marks'); A8-14, A8-15, A8-16; B8-10, B8-11, B8-12; FS line 623 (No-shows: 'A missed visit is marked 15 minutes after the start; safety first where the welfare switch applies; then the customer is asked; no fee until the owner decides'); S11-22; Q-06

columns.name: visit_id
columns.description: The visit marked (K-30 booking_visits.id), held to its booking by no_shows_visit_fk: one mark per visit.
columns.source: A8-14; B8-10; K-30 v1 booking_visits ('The visit part (K-31) names it for ... no-shows')

columns.name: booking_id
columns.description: The visit's booking (K-04 bookings.id).
columns.source: FS line 729

columns.name: business_id
columns.description: The booking's business (README rule 5), so row-level security can scope the row.
columns.source: arch 10 line 546

columns.name: marked_at
columns.description: When the no-show was marked ('NO SHOW Alex M.'): 15 minutes after the start, 10 for a video or phone session nobody joined (code holds it to the visit's start: README rule 10).
columns.source: A8-14 ('15 minutes after the start, Riley marks a no-show'; 'A video or phone session nobody joined: after 10 minutes'); B8-10; FS line 623

columns.name: marked_by_person_id
columns.description: Who marked it (persons.id): the pro or the desk.

columns.name: marked_via
columns.description: staff_text (from their own phone) or today_page (the owner console).
columns.source: A8-14; FS lines 618, 623

columns.name: welfare_first
columns.description: Whether a safety check comes first: the plug-in's welfare switch is on, someone on the booking is marked in care, or the booker said they may be unable to answer.
columns.source: A8-14 ('Where the welfare switch is on, or someone on the booking is in care: a safety check comes first'); B8-10 ('May be unable to answer: ... or a booker who said so'); RULES 4.12

columns.name: found_safe_at
columns.description: With a safety check: when they were found safe, by a reply or the business's own calls; no fee or no-show words go to anyone before it.
columns.source: A8-14 ('No fee words until they're found safe'); B8-10 ('No fee or no-show words go to anyone until they're found safe')

columns.name: owner_told_at
columns.description: With a safety check: when the owner was told they were not reached in 30 minutes, and the plug-in's welfare plan runs. Rosie's own messages go by text to open chats and by email; Rosie places no call (Q-06).
columns.source: A8-14 ('Not reached in 30 minutes: Sam is told, and the plug-in's welfare plan runs'); B8-10; Q-06

columns.name: asked_at
columns.description: When the customer was asked to reply within 30 minutes ('If you're here, please reply within 30 minutes'), after any safety check found them safe.
columns.source: A8-14; B8-10 ('Found safe and simply out, or no welfare need: ... This message then goes')

columns.name: reply_by
columns.description: 30 minutes after asked_at: the customer is heard before the owner decides anything.
columns.source: A8-15 ('Does Alex reply in 30 minutes?'; 'The customer is heard before Sam decides anything'); B8-11

columns.name: open_question_id
columns.description: The question sent (K-04 open_questions.id): 'Reply 3 I'm here'.
columns.source: A8-14; K-04 v1 open_questions

columns.name: replied_at
columns.description: When the customer replied.

columns.name: reply
columns.description: here (3 I'm here, or home: they or another adult on the booking is there), on_way ('On my way', 'I'm outside', 'Be there in 2 minutes': held to the grace time), cancelled ('I cancelled': the record is checked) or emergency (an emergency reason, which goes to the owner with any fee question, in their words only if nothing private).
columns.source: A8-14 ('On my way or I'm outside: Riley is told, and the time is held to the grace time'; 'I cancelled: the record is checked'); A8-15; B8-11 ('Means I'm home: any reply saying Alex or another adult on the booking is there'; 'An emergency reason goes to Sam with the fee question')

columns.name: outcome
columns.description: checked_in (they came after all: checked in with the code, a normal visit, no fee), not_met (they said they were there but still could not be met: nothing is charged now, and any fee is the owner's question with the facts), no_visit (no reply in the 30 minutes: no visit; any fee is the owner's call, and silence charges nothing) or cancelled_before (the record shows they cancelled first: no no-show). Set once.
columns.source: A8-16; B8-12 ('Still can't meet after they said they're there: nothing is charged now'); A8-15 ('No reply ... No visit. Any fee is Sam's call; silence charges nothing'); B8-11; A8-14 ('I cancelled: the record is checked')

tables.name: visit_events
tables.description: Events on the way to a visit and at its door, appended and never edited: the pro's on-my-way text with the arrival time (flow B); a LATE fanned out to this visit, with the new start or window and the visit's own question (both flows); and flow B's door events: the customer says the person at the door isn't the pro (and then that it was after all), only a child answers, and the agreed way in fails (and a new one comes on the secure page).
tables.source: 02-contracts section 7 row K-31 ('on-my-way and door events (flow B)'; 'the late row fanned out to that worker's later visits (arch 09 line 484)'); arch 09 line 484; B8-02; B8-91; A7-14; B7-18; B8-03; B8-07; B8-09; B8-52

columns.description: The event's id: an opaque string code makes and never parses (CQ-09).

columns.name: visit_id

columns.name: booking_id
columns.description: The visit's booking (K-04 bookings.id).
columns.source: FS line 729

columns.name: business_id
columns.description: The booking's business (README rule 5), so row-level security can scope the row.
columns.source: arch 10 line 546

columns.name: kind
columns.description: on_my_way (OMW: the person who meets the pro gets the pro's name and photo, the arrival time and the code to give at the door), late (this visit's share of a late report: its new start or window and its own question), not_the_pro (2 It isn't Jordan, by a reply, a call to the business line or any words: the door stays shut and the owner reaches them at once), was_the_pro (1 It was Jordan after all: the visit goes on), only_child_home (only a child answers where an adult must be there: the pro waits up to 30 minutes), way_in_failed (the agreed way in fails: a new one is asked on the secure page within 15 minutes) or way_in_fixed (a new way in came, by the page or by text).
columns.source: B8-02 ('Must carry: the business, the pro's name and photo, the arrival time, and the code and where to give it'); B8-91; A7-14; B7-18; B8-07; B8-09; B8-52

columns.description: Whose word it is (persons.id): the pro (on_my_way, only_child_home, way_in_failed) or the customer (not_the_pro, was_the_pro, way_in_fixed). Null for late, whose word the late report carries.

tables.name: visit_checks
tables.description: The visit check (D98): the day after a booking Rosie brought in that has no check-in code and no DONE, Rosie asks the customer once, their way and in text hours, 'Did your visit with <business> happen?'. The answer is recorded only, for Rosie's team: no charge, refund, fee or other action follows, and the business never sees it (README rule 6: no Tool API grant). Not for sensitive work, a private booking or a number that sent STOP. One per visit; the answer is set once.
tables.source: FS line 740 (visit_check: 'id, booking_id, asked_at, answer (yes, no, none), answered_at, channel. For Rosie's team; no action follows'); FS line 624; FS line 670 (screen 20); A8-47; B8-47; D98; 02-contracts section 7 row K-31 ('the visit check (asked, answer, channel; for Rosie's team only, with no action: FS visit_check row, D98)')
